definition: Stable city directory identifier.
block = populated Census blocks; tract = populated city-limit tract portions. These are separate networks.
Category assigned to nodes by the largest of White-alone, Black-alone, Hispanic-any-race, Asian-alone counts. Counts themselves overlap; assigned node labels do not.
Zero-based position in nodes.csv, adjacency and R; B_node_indices maps each category B to these indices.
Census GEOID preserved as text:15digits block,11digits tract.
Number of neighboring nodes of any category within1km, excluding self.
Whether this category exceeds50% of this node population. Diagnostic only; assignment uses the largest of four counts.
Whether this node is assigned to this category under the dominant-category rule.
Assigned to this category and has at least one geographic neighbor; contributes to the city SSI denominator.
No other populated city node within1km; excluded from SSI, retained in population counts.
Number of1km neighbors assigned to this row category, including for rows not assigned themselves.
Zero-based connected-component ID within this city/scale/category. -1 when ineligible.
Eligible nodes in this same-category component. Zero when ineligible.
Perron eigenvalue of induced B for this component; same for every node in the component. Blank when ineligible.
Right Perron vector component, scaled to sum1 within component. Singleton with B=0 uses vector1. Blank when ineligible.
component_size*component_eigenvalue*component_eigenvector. Mean over eligible assigned nodes equals citySSI. Can exceed1; no clipping. Blank when ineligible.
Maximum component absolute residual B*v-lambda*v; repeated for component members.
Total node population, not category population.
Number of this category residents in this node, regardless of assigned category.
Node category population/node total population.
group_population/city_population, fraction0–1. Uses all residents, not the fraction of assigned nodes or only eligible nodes.
City-level category SSI, repeated for interpretation; not a node eigenvalue.
